summary: Maintain agent guidance at the narrowest user, repository, nested, or private scope through exact approved edits.

outcomes: Choose the narrowest guidance scope that owns a recurring agent decision.
Apply independently approved instruction changes without leaking private context.

scenarios.title: Fix a repository instruction gap
scenarios.prompt: Use $maintain-agent-guidance to propose a durable repository rule for this repeated agent failure and wait for approval before editing.
scenarios.outcome: The user receives a minimal exact proposal targeted to the applicable AGENTS.md file.

scenarios.title: Keep workstation guidance private
scenarios.prompt: Use $maintain-agent-guidance to record this machine-specific workflow without exposing it to repository contributors.
scenarios.outcome: The approved rule is placed in private local guidance and the Git exclusion is verified.
